How It Works

Annotation Workflow

A battle-tested 6-step pipeline from raw data to deployment-ready labels.

01
Requirements Ontology Design Security Review

Intake & Scope

Requirements workshop, ontology design, and data security protocols.

Scope Doc Timeline Sign-off
02
Platform Config Templates QA Criteria

Tooling Setup

Configure annotation platform, labeling templates, and QA criteria.

Sandbox Access Setup Test Batch
03
2-5% Sample Gold Standard Calibration

Pilot Batch

Annotate 2–5% sample; calibrate annotators with gold-standard review.

Feedback Loop Annotator Scoring Adjustments
04
Specialist Teams Real-time Dashboards Full-scale Labeling

Annotation

Full-scale labeling by specialist teams with real-time dashboards.

Daily Throughput Progress Tracking Escalations
05
Automated Checks Expert Audit Multi-tier Review

QA Review

Multi-tier review: automated checks + expert human audit.

Error Analysis Rework Queue Accuracy Report
06
COCO / VOC CSV / JSONL Secure Transfer

Delivery

Export in your format (COCO, Pascal VOC, CSV, JSONL) via API or secure transfer.

API Delivery Versioning Handoff Docs
